findings.title: Review fix has no test that fails first
findings.description: The review-round fix in `real_text` changes only how many digits are formatted (18 first, with a 767-digit fallback for a `500` tail), and the round-2 report admits that no test can fail on the pre-fix code. The added test `real_text_of_18_digits_is_the_text_of_the_exact_number` compares the new path with a helper that uses the exact-digit path, so it passes on the old output and gives no before/after signal for the fix. A later change that reintroduces the slow path would not be caught by a test that fails before the fix.

findings.title: A new error case appears that no ticket asks for
findings.description: `equal` and `compare` now return the error "a value that is not a number has no order" when `order` yields `None` (a NaN operand). No acceptance criterion asks for this error, and `finite` stops every NaN from becoming a value, so this path can't be reached. It is untested error code with its own message outside the ticket.

findings.title: Engine gains a public text function no ticket asks for
findings.description: The PR adds `pub fn real_text(f64) -> Option<String>` to the engine crate's public API and documents it in README.md. Ticket #45 only asks that `server/` and `site/wasm/` print a real value as SQLite's `CAST(<real> AS TEXT)` does, and `CAST ... AS TEXT` stays unsupported in the engine, so this new public engine function sits outside the ticket contract.
